stages.title: Avengers: Age of Ultron
stages.text: After S.H.I.E.L.D. falls, Maria Hill goes to work for Tony Stark and runs operations for the Avengers out of his tower. She coordinates the team from the raid on Strucker's base to the Battle of Sokovia.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Hill's boss. She runs Avengers operations out of his tower.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's operations chief for the Avengers, working out of his tower.

proposed.title: The Avengers
proposed.text: On the Helicarrier bridge, Hill asks when Tony became an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics, and he says it was the night before.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Stark, who claims he learned the Tesseract science overnight.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's deputy, who doubts Tony's Tesseract know-how.

their_evidence: Helicarrier bridge: Hill: 'When did you become an expert in thermonuclear astrophysics?' Tony: 'Last night.'

stages.title: Iron Man 2
stages.text: Nick Fury is Natasha Romanoff's director at S.H.I.E.L.D., and he sends her undercover to keep an eye on Tony Stark.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's director, who sends her undercover to watch Tony Stark.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fury's agent, sent undercover to keep an eye on Tony Stark.

stages.title: Captain America: The Winter Soldier
stages.text: Fury is one of the few people Natasha fully trusts. When Hydra is exposed, she fights at his side to bring S.H.I.E.L.D. down.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: One of the few people Natasha fully trusts. She fights by his side.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A trusted friend who fights at Fury's side to bring down S.H.I.E.L.D.

proposed.title: The Avengers
proposed.text: For Fury's Avengers Initiative, Natasha brings Bruce Banner in from Kolkata, then works under Fury on the Helicarrier in the hunt for Loki.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Natasha's director, whose initiative she recruits Banner for.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Agent who brings Banner in for Fury's initiative.

their_evidence: Fury reactivates the Avengers Initiative; Romanoff travels to Kolkata to recruit Banner and brings him to the Helicarrier, where Fury thanks Banner for coming.

stages.title: Captain Marvel
stages.text: Phil Coulson is one of Nick Fury's most trusted agents at S.H.I.E.L.D., working under him from 1995 on.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: One of Fury's most trusted agents, working under him from 1995 on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The senior agent Coulson works under at S.H.I.E.L.D. from 1995 on.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1
stages.text: Back on duty after Loki's attack, Coulson leads a field team for S.H.I.E.L.D. under Director Fury.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fury's agent, back on duty after Loki's attack and leading a field team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, who oversees his new field team.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#11
stages.text: Coulson learns he was dead for days after Loki's attack and was brought back to life on Fury's orders.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury had brought back from the dead.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's director, on whose orders he was brought back from the dead.

stages.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D. S1#22
stages.text: Fury joins Coulson to face Garrett, then names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The agent Fury names the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Coulson's old boss, who names him the new Director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

proposed.title: The Avengers
proposed.text: Coulson serves Fury through the hunt for Loki until Loki kills him on the Helicarrier. Fury then uses his death to push the Avengers to come together.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Fury's loyal agent, killed by Loki. His death rallies the Avengers.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The director Coulson serves to the end, who uses his death to rally the team.

their_evidence: Coulson dies telling Fury 'I'm sorry, boss. The god rabbited'; Fury uses Coulson's death (and his trading cards) to motivate the Avengers.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: Phil Coulson keeps approaching Pepper Potts to set up a S.H.I.E.L.D. debriefing with Tony, and the two become friendly.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. agent who keeps asking for Tony and becomes a friend.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's assistant, whom Coulson keeps asking for a debriefing.

proposed.title: The Avengers
proposed.text: Coulson brings the Avengers file to Stark Tower, and Pepper greets him warmly by his first name and invites him in.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A S.H.I.E.L.D. friend Pepper welcomes to Stark Tower by name.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's partner, who welcomes Coulson to Stark Tower by name.

their_evidence: Stark Tower: Coulson arrives with the Avengers Initiative file; Pepper welcomes 'Phil' in, and she and Tony talk with him about the Avengers.

stages.title: Iron Man
stages.text: J.A.R.V.I.S. is the A.I. that runs Tony's mansion and his armor. As Tony's assistant, Pepper deals with him every day.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Tony's A.I., who runs the house Pepper manages.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's assistant, who works with J.A.R.V.I.S. every day.

question: During the Battle of New York J.A.R.V.I.S. asks Tony 'shall I try Miss Potts?' and places a call Pepper misses. Count that unanswered call as a stage between Pepper and J.A.R.V.I.S. here?

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Betty Brant is Peter's classmate at Midtown High, where she co-hosts the school news and often reports on Spider-Man. After he saves the decathlon team at the Washington Monument, she and Jason thank Spider-Man on the air.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate whose Washington Monument rescue Betty reports on.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate who co-hosts the school news and reports on Spider-Man.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Betty reports Peter's return to Midtown for the school news and cheers him on, calling him tiger, or rather spider.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate whose return to school Betty reports.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A classmate who cheers his return to school on the school news.

their_evidence: Theatrical cut: as Peter returns to Midtown, Betty reports it to Midtown News: 'Go get 'em, tiger! Or, should I say, spider.'

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Julius Dell is Peter Parker's teacher at Midtown and one of the chaperones on his class trip to Europe. Peter saves him from the attacks there.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A student Dell chaperones, who saves him from the attacks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's teacher, a chaperone on the Europe trip whom he saves.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Mr. Dell welcomes Peter back to Midtown as a hero and, with Mr. Harrington, tells him to ignore Coach Wilson calling him a murderer.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A student Dell welcomes back to Midtown as a hero.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's teacher, who welcomes him back to Midtown as a hero.

their_evidence: Dell and Harrington greet Peter outside their classrooms on his return ('We would love to welcome you back to Midtown High. Where we shape heroes'); when Wilson calls Peter a murderer they tell him not to listen.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Peter at Midtown High and coaches the academic decathlon team, happily welcoming him back for Nationals. Spider-Man saves him and the team from the falling Washington Monument elevator.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's teacher and decathlon coach, whom he saves at the monument.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student and decathlon team member, whom he welcomes back.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Mr. Harrington greets Peter warmly on his return to Midtown, shows him a display case made in his honor and tells him to ignore Coach Wilson.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's teacher, who shows him a display case in his honor.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A student Harrington welcomes back with a display case in his honor.

their_evidence: Harrington builds a display case with their Venice photo, shows it to Peter on his return, and calls Wilson a conspiracy theorist to ignore.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Julius Dell and Roger Harrington are fellow teachers at Midtown who chaperone the class trip to Europe together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow teacher and chaperone on the Europe trip.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow teacher and chaperone on the Europe trip.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Mr. Dell and Mr. Harrington greet Peter together on his return to Midtown and tell him to ignore Coach Wilson.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow teacher who welcomes Peter back with Dell.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow teacher who welcomes Peter back with Harrington.

their_evidence: Dell and Harrington greet Peter together outside their classrooms and both tell him not to listen to Wilson.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Flash is a classmate on the academic decathlon team who keeps mocking Peter and Ned. At Liz's party he taunts them over Ned's claim that Peter knows Spider-Man.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate who keeps mocking Ned and Peter.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, whom Flash mocks along with Peter.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Flash cuts Ned off in front of the crowd outside Midtown to call himself Spider-Man's best friend and plug his book, and Ned walks off annoyed.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A classmate who claims to be Peter's best friend over Ned.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's best friend, whom Flash talks over to plug his book.

their_evidence: When a protester asks Ned who he is, Flash interrupts to say he is Spider-Man's best friend and advertises Flashpoint, causing Ned to walk off in annoyance.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: J. Jonah Jameson brands Spider-Man a menace and reveals to the world that he is Peter Parker.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Jameson brands a menace and unmasks to the world.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The broadcaster who brands Peter a menace and reveals his identity to the world.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Jameson blames Spider-Man for the destruction at Happy's building and May's death. Peter calls in to his broadcast to admit he brought the villains and say where he will be.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The hero Jameson blames for May's death, who calls in to his broadcast.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The broadcaster who blames Peter for May's death and airs his call.

their_evidence: Jameson reports from the destroyed condo that Spider-Man is responsible for the destruction and May's death; Peter later calls in via video broadcast admitting he brought the perpetrators and revealing the Statue of Liberty.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: In London, Happy finds MJ and her classmates and hides them from Mysterio's drones in the Tower of London, where MJ smashes one with a mace.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's friend, one of the kids Happy shelters from Mysterio's drones.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Tony's former head of security, who hides MJ and the others from Mysterio's drones.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Happy barges into Peter's bedroom at the Parkers' apartment and finds MJ there with Peter, just as the news of Peter's identity surrounds the building.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's girlfriend, whom Happy finds in Peter's room.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The man who barges into Peter's room and finds MJ there.

their_evidence: Opening scene: Hogan insists on checking a noise and opens Peter's bedroom door to find Peter and MJ, who came in through the window; they then watch the NY1 report together.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
stages.text: Ned is Peter's best friend and a regular at the Parkers' apartment. May lets him in to build Lego with Peter and drives the two of them to Liz's party.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend, always at May's apartment building Lego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, who drives Ned and Peter to Liz's party.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: May and Ned are brought in together to the police precinct for Damage Control's questioning, walking past Peter's room on the way.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Peter's best friend, brought in for questioning with May.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Peter's aunt, brought in for questioning with Ned.

their_evidence: May is asked to come to the precinct and meets Ned and MJ, who were called in too; they pass Peter's room together and she tells him not to talk without a lawyer.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel#1
stages.text: At the Damage Control office, Sadie Deever shows Cleary a video of the enhanced girl from AvengerCon. He orders her to bring the girl in.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Damage Control agent Cleary sends to bring in Ms. Marvel.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sadie's Damage Control superior, who orders her to bring in Ms. Marvel.

stages.title: Ms. Marvel#6
stages.text: Sadie Deever ignores Cleary's order to stand down and storms Coles Academic High School after Kamran and Ms. Marvel. Cleary relieves her of duty.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A Damage Control agent who defies Cleary's orders, until he relieves her of duty.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Sadie's superior, who relieves her of duty for defying him.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Sadie Deever is among the Damage Control agents watching as Cleary interrogates Ned and MJ.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: An agent who watches his interrogation of Ned and MJ.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: The agent leading the interrogation she watches.

their_evidence: Uncredited: Deever oversees Cleary's interrogations of MJ and Ned (confirmed by the actress); no lines between them.

stages.title: Venom
stages.text: Eddie Brock bonds with the alien symbiote Venom while exposing the Life Foundation. Venom comes to like Eddie and turns against his own kind to protect Earth, and the two stay bonded, eating only criminals.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The alien symbiote who lives inside Eddie.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Venom's host, a fellow loser he grows fond of.

stages.title: Venom: Let There Be Carnage
stages.text: Eddie and Venom fight over Venom's need to eat people, and Venom leaves him. They make up to stop Carnage at Grace Cathedral, then go on the run together.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Leaves Eddie, then returns to fight Carnage.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Venom's host, whom he leaves, then makes up with.

stages.title: Venom: The Last Dance
stages.text: Hunted for the Codex they carry, Eddie and Venom flee across the country. At Area 55, Venom gives his life to destroy the Codex and the Xenophages, and says goodbye to Eddie.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Eddie's symbiote, who dies saving him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Venom's host, whom he dies to protect.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Stranded in a strange world, Eddie decides to go meet Spider-Man while Venom would rather go skinny dipping. They are pulled back home, leaving a piece of Venom behind.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The symbiote stranded with Eddie, who wants a swim instead.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Venom's host, stranded with him in a strange world.

their_evidence: Mid-credits scene: at a bar, Eddie wants to go to New York to meet Spider-Man, Venom suggests skinny dipping, then they are transported back, leaving a symbiote fragment.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Roger Harrington teaches Betty and seats her next to Ned on the flight to Europe, where their romance begins.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's teacher, who seats her next to Ned on the flight.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student, whom he seats next to Ned on the flight.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Betty interviews Mr. Harrington about Peter for the school news, and he admits his ex-wife now believes the Mysterio theories.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's teacher, whom she interviews about Peter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Harrington's student, who interviews him about Peter.

their_evidence: Extended cut only ('The More Fun Stuff Version'): Betty interviews Harrington about being Peter's teacher and the Mysterio theories; not in the theatrical cut.

stages.title: Spider-Man: Far From Home
stages.text: Julius Dell is Betty Brant's history teacher at Midtown and one of the chaperones on her class trip to Europe.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's teacher at Midtown.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Dell's student on the class trip to Europe.

proposed.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
proposed.text: Betty interviews Mr. Dell about Peter for the school news, and he tells her what he would be if he were Spider-Man.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: Betty's history teacher, whom she interviews about Peter.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Dell's student, who interviews him about Peter.

their_evidence: Extended cut only ('The More Fun Stuff Version'): Betty interviews her history teacher Dell, who tells her what he would be if he was Spider-Man; not in the theatrical cut.

question: Two stages rest only on the extended cut (Spider-Man: No Way Home, The More Fun Stuff Version): Betty interviewing Harrington and Dell for the school news. Count extended-cut scenes as part of the film?
Sadie Deever's appearance is an uncredited background role at Cleary's interrogations, confirmed by the actress. Keep the stage?

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Rocket steals Ayesha's Anulax batteries, and she hunts the Guardians for revenge.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The thief who steals Ayesha's Anulax batteries.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Sovereign leader Rocket robs, who hunts him for revenge.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Threatened by the High Evolutionary, Ayesha hunts Rocket to Counter-Earth and sends Adam to seize him for her creator.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The Guardian Ayesha must hand over to the High Evolutionary.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Hunts Rocket down for the High Evolutionary.

their_evidence: The High Evolutionary orders Ayesha to bring him 89P13 (Rocket) or he will destroy the Sovereign; she tracks Gamora's ship to Counter-Earth and tells Adam they must capture Rocket first, and Adam goes after him at the Bowie.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Groot break out of the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. When the regrown Groot dances behind Drax's back, he freezes every time Drax looks his way.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Baby Groot freezes whenever Drax looks.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow escapee and founding Guardian. Groot dances behind his back.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Drax captive aboard Arête, Groot joins the Guardians' rescue and they fight side by side through the ship.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who helps rescue Drax from Arête.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Groot helps rescue from Arête.

their_evidence: Drax, Nebula and Mantis are captured aboard Arête; the other Guardians, Groot among them, mount the rescue and battle the High Evolutionary's forces together.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis bonds with Drax on Ego's planet and reveals Ego's true plan to him. The two become best friends.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Drax's best friend. Reveals Ego's plan to him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Mantis's best friend. They bond on Ego's planet.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Drax talks Mantis into chasing after Quill on Counter-Earth, and when they are caught aboard Arête she defends him to Nebula and tames three Abilisks to carry them out.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who defends Drax and tames the Abilisks to free him.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who talks Mantis into chasing Quill.

their_evidence: Drax tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group; aboard Arête Mantis defends Drax when Nebula berates him, and she calms three Abilisks which carry Drax, Nebula and Mantis out.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Drax and Quill first meet as inmates in the Kyln and become founding Guardians. Drax looks out for Quill like a brother.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Drax looks out for him like a brother.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow inmate and Guardian. Looks out for Quill like a brother.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Quill leads the rescue when Drax is taken captive aboard Arête, then tells the team he is leaving them to go home to Earth.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: The friend who leads the rescue from Arête, then leaves for Earth.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Quill rescues from Arête before leaving the team.

their_evidence: Quill calls Kraglin to bring Knowhere so the Guardians can rescue Nebula, Drax and Mantis; afterwards Quill gathers the Guardians and announces he is returning to Earth.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Gamora and Groot first meet brawling over the Orb on Xandar, escape the Kyln together and become founding Guardians. Groot gives his life to shield the team when the Dark Aster crashes.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, who gives his life to shield the team.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, first met brawling over the Orb on Xandar.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Gamora looks out for the young Groot in battle, warning him out of harm's way during the fight with the Abilisk.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Fellow founding Guardian, whom Gamora looks out for as a youngster.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Fellow founding Guardian, who looks out for Groot in battle.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Gamora flies in to pick up Quill and Groot after they leap from the rising Arête with Theel.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian Gamora picks up after he leaps from Arête.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who picks Groot up after his leap from Arête.

their_evidence: Quill and Groot jump off Arête with Theel, kill him for the override code, and are rescued by Gamora on their ship.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis arrives with Ego to meet Quill and Gamora, and she joins the Guardians after they defeat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Ego's ward, who joins the Guardians after his defeat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Guardian Mantis meets with Ego, and joins after his defeat.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: On Counter-Earth Mantis stays behind with Gamora to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks her into going after Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A Guardian who stays with Gamora to guard Rocket.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager Mantis guards Rocket with on Counter-Earth.

their_evidence: At Counter-Earth Drax and Mantis remain with Gamora and Rocket; Drax tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group, leaving Gamora to fight War Pig and Adam.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula tricks the young Groot into freeing her from her restraints, then joins Taserface's mutiny. She later comes around and fights alongside Groot against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Captive who tricks Groot into freeing her, then fights beside him.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A young Guardian Nebula tricks into freeing her, then fights beside against Ego.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Nebula radios Groot to bring the ship for the escape from the Orgoscope, then drives with him and Quill to the High Evolutionary's complex.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate who radios Groot for the escape and rides with him to Arête.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate Nebula calls for the escape and rides with to Arête.

their_evidence: Escaping the Orgoscope, Nebula contacts Groot to pick them up in the Bowie; on Counter-Earth Nebula joins Quill and Groot to find Theel at Arête Laboratories.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Groot and Rocket first try to cash in on the bounty on Peter Quill, then team up with him as founding Guardians. Groot sacrifices himself to save the team.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Bounty turned fellow founding Guardian, whom Groot gives his life to save.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Bounty hunter turned founding Guardian, who sacrifices himself for the team.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Quill and Groot go into Arête together, then jump off the rising ship with Theel and take the override code that saves Rocket.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who goes into Arête with Groot and gets the code.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend who leaps off Arête with Quill to get the code.

their_evidence: Quill and Groot enter Arête, jump off the ship with Theel and retrieve the override code from his corpse, which Quill uses to restart Rocket's heart.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Taserface's mutiny, Kraglin fits Nebula with a new cybernetic hand and gives her a ship so she can hunt down Gamora on Ego's planet.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, whom Kraglin fits with a hand and a ship.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager who gives Nebula a new hand and a ship to hunt Gamora.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Kraglin's misfired arrow stabs Nebula on Knowhere, and later she radios him to lock Knowhere onto Arête so everyone can escape.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Kraglin stabs by mistake, who later radios him for the escape.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate whose arrow stabs Nebula, who locks Knowhere on for the escape.

their_evidence: During target practice Kraglin fails to control the Yaka Arrow and stabs Nebula in the chest; later Nebula contacts him to interlock Knowhere with Arête so they can escape.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Kraglin is a Ravager on the crew of Yondu Udonta, who raised Quill, and he flies with the Ravagers beside the Guardians at the Battle of Xandar.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The boy Yondu raised, whom Kraglin flies beside at Xandar.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A Ravager from the crew that raised Peter.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: After Yondu's death, Kraglin joins the Guardians and becomes Quill's friend.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Kraglin's friend and new teammate.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new Guardian and friend after Yondu's death.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Quill leaves Kraglin in charge of Knowhere, then calls him to fly it to Arête and blast an opening for the rescue.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A friend who leaves Kraglin in charge and calls him in for the rescue.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A friend Quill leaves in charge of Knowhere and calls in for the rescue.

their_evidence: Quill tells Kraglin and Cosmo they are in charge of Knowhere while the Guardians leave, and later contacts Kraglin to pilot Knowhere to Arête and blast a hole in the spaceport.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula and Mantis meet on Ego's planet, where Mantis tells her and Gamora about Ego's dead children. They then fight on the same side against Ego.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's sister, who fights beside Mantis against Ego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Arrives with Ego and fights beside Nebula against him.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Mantis and Nebula are caught together aboard Arête, where Mantis calls Nebula out for always finding fault, then tames three Abilisks to free them.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis calls out, then frees with the Abilisks.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who calls Nebula out and frees her with the Abilisks.

their_evidence: Aboard Arête Nebula insults Mantis, and Mantis says Nebula finds fault in everyone to make herself feel okay; captured in a pit, Mantis calms three Abilisks that carry Nebula, Drax and Mantis out.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Mantis joins the Guardians after Ego's defeat, and when she first sees Rocket she thinks he is a pet and asks to pat him.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis mistakes for a pet and asks to pat.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A new teammate who mistakes Rocket for a pet.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Mantis stays on Counter-Earth to guard the dying Rocket, until Drax talks her into going after Quill.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Mantis stays behind to guard.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who stays behind to guard Rocket.

their_evidence: At Counter-Earth Drax and Mantis remain with Gamora and Rocket while Quill, Groot and Nebula go to Arête; Drax then tricks Mantis into pursuing Quill's group.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Martinex is Stakar Ogord's first mate and longtime teammate in the Ravagers. He stays at Stakar's side after their old team breaks up, and they bring the crew back together after Yondu's death.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: His captain. As first mate, Martinex helps him reunite the old crew.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Stakar's first mate and longtime teammate in the Ravagers.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Martinex and Stakar are with the United Ravagers who help the Guardians into the Orgoscope, and they welcome Gamora back aboard afterwards.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: His captain. They welcome Gamora back to the Ravagers together.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: Stakar's first mate in the United Ravagers.

their_evidence: The United Ravagers board the Bowie and Stakar explains the Orgoscope plan; afterwards Martinex picks Gamora up from Knowhere and Stakar embraces her and says 'Welcome home.'

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy
stages.text: Nebula is one of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Gamora and Quill across the galaxy for the Orb.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A thief Nebula chases across the galaxy for the Orb.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: One of Ronan's lieutenants, chasing Quill and Gamora for the Orb.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: Nebula comes after Gamora again on Ego's planet, but she ends up fighting beside Quill and the Guardians against Ego before leaving to hunt Thanos.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: Gamora's teammate, whom Nebula fights beside against Ego.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: Gamora's sister, who fights beside Quill against Ego, then leaves.

stages.title: Avengers: Infinity War
stages.text: Nebula joins the fight against Thanos on Titan, and her revelation that Thanos killed Gamora sends Quill into a rage.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: An ally on Titan, whom Nebula's news about Gamora sends into a rage.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: An ally on Titan who reveals Thanos killed Gamora.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Nebula keeps carrying the drunk, grieving Quill to bed on Knowhere, and he mistakes her for Gamora. She later stops Gamora from attacking him.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Nebula looks after through his grief.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who carries Quill to bed and defends him.

their_evidence: Nebula carries the drunk Quill to his room, where he thinks she is Gamora; Mantis tells her 'He's your brother'; when Gamora attacks Quill, Nebula stops her.

stages.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
stages.text: As Ego's planet falls apart, Kraglin flies in to pick up the Guardians, and Drax lifts Mantis up to the ship. Both end up on the team afterward.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: The empath Kraglin helps pull off Ego's planet.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: The Ravager who flies in to save Mantis and the Guardians from Ego.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: On Knowhere, Kraglin tells Mantis how Yondu ruined Quill's childhood Christmas. The story moves her to give Quill a real Christmas.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Guardian Kraglin tells about Yondu and Christmas.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian whose Yondu story inspires Mantis's Christmas plan.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: When the High Evolutionary takes Mantis captive aboard Arête, Kraglin flies Knowhere in and blasts a way into the ship for the rescue.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A teammate Kraglin flies Knowhere in to rescue.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A teammate who flies Knowhere in to rescue Mantis.

their_evidence: Quill tells Kraglin they need his help to save Nebula, Drax and Mantis from the High Evolutionary, and Kraglin pilots Knowhere to Arête and blasts a hole in it.

stages.title: The Guardians of the Galaxy Holiday Special
stages.text: Cosmo, a telepathic dog, joins the Guardians when they buy Knowhere. At Christmas she and Rocket decorate Groot like a tree, and when he drops his arms she complains that he ruined Christmas.
stages.on_a_card_about_b: A telepathic dog on the Guardians. Says Groot ruined Christmas.
stages.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Guardian Cosmo and Rocket decorate like a Christmas tree.

proposed.title: Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 3
proposed.text: Groot and Cosmo join the new Guardians under Rocket and charge together into a stampede to defend a settlement on Krylor.
proposed.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow new Guardian on Rocket's team.
proposed.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow new Guardian on Rocket's team.

their_evidence: The new Guardians led by Rocket, including Groot, Cosmo, Kraglin, Adam, Phyla and Blurp, defend a settlement on Krylor from a stampede.
